_comment: TestbenchDAQ configuration. Copy this file to config.json and adjust the paths.
_build_gator: cd gator_recorder && cmake -B build -DGTR_API_DIR=/path/to/raspberry-pi4 . && cmake --build build
_run_count_doc: Number of sequential runs to execute. Integer >= 1.
_run_duration_s_doc: Duration of each run in seconds. Float > 0, or null for manual stop (press Enter).
_run_period_s_doc: Start-to-start interval between runs in seconds. Must be >= run_duration_s. null = start next run immediately after the previous one finishes.

gator._binary_path_doc: Absolute or relative path to the compiled gator_recorder binary.
gator._library_path_doc: Directory containing libgtrlib-pub-shared-v*.so. Prepended to LD_LIBRARY_PATH at runtime.
gator._channel_doc: Switched Gator channel to sample. Integer 1-8.
gator._samplerate_doc: Sample rate in Hz. Allowed values: 1000 | 5000 | 10000 | 19000. null = keep device default (1000 Hz).
gator._fullscale_doc: Full-scale input range. Integer 8-127 (unit: 5 nA steps, so 8 = 40 nA, 127 = 635 nA). Lower = more sensitive. null = keep device default (120).
gator._threshold_doc: Detection threshold as a fraction of the full-scale reading. Float 0.0-1.0. Samples below this are reported as wavelength=0 (invalid). null = keep device default (0.2).

endaq._ide2csv_path_doc: Path to the ide2csv executable used to convert the raw .IDE recording to CSV after each run. null = skip conversion (the raw .IDE file is still offloaded).
